journey.name: spark transfer to spending
journey.description:
Verifies the transfer to spending flow on Spark. With Spark ready, the Spending suggestion card opens the "Spending Balance" intro once, then Funding, which leads with "Transfer from Savings" (testTag "FundTransfer") and "Use Other Wallet" (testTag "FundReceive") above "Manual Setup" (testTag "FundManual"). Transfer from Savings opens the "Transfer to spending" intro once, then the amount screen (testTag "SpendingAmount"). The confirm screen shows "Network fees", "Spending fee", "To spending" and "Total", and the Instant and Later rows: Both rows show their fee as "±" in sats and fiat, and picking a row updates the Spending fee and To spending tiles. Learn more explains Instant and Later. Whether the provider offers Instant needs a real deposit Spark sees, so this journey stops before the swipe; the states after it are covered by SettingUpScreen previews and SparkRepoTest.
Precondition: dev build with Spark connected on its regtest (no key needed), built with `ESPLORA_URL` on Spark's regtest chain through `scripts/spark-regtest-esplora.py` (without it the transfer opens the Transfer Unavailable sheet), a freshly onboarded wallet (so neither intro has been seen) with a positive on-chain Savings balance and no channels, and the Spending suggestion card on Home. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap the Spending suggestion card and verify the "Spending Balance" intro opens; tap "Get Started" (testTag "TransferIntro-button")
Verify "Transfer from Savings" (testTag "FundTransfer") and "Use Other Wallet" (testTag "FundReceive") are enabled above "Manual Setup" (testTag "FundManual")
Tap "Transfer from Savings" and verify the "Transfer to spending" intro opens; tap "Get Started" (testTag "SpendingIntro-button")
Verify the amount screen (testTag "SpendingAmount") opens and wait until the available amount (testTag "SpendingAmountAvailable") shows a positive value
Tap "25%" (testTag "SpendingAmountQuarter") and verify the amount is a quarter of the available amount; tap "Max" (testTag "SpendingAmountMax") and verify it equals the available amount

Tap "Continue" (testTag "SpendingAmountContinue") and verify the confirm screen shows "Network fees", "Spending fee", "To spending" and "Total", with "Instant" (testTag "SpendingConfirmInstant") selected and its fee shown as "±"
Tap "Later" (testTag "SpendingConfirmLater") and verify the Spending fee shows "±" with a lower amount and "To spending" grows by the difference
Tap "Learn More" (testTag "SpendingConfirmMore"), verify the "Transfer speed" screen with the spending balance bar, and tap "Understood" (testTag "LiquidityContinue")
Verify the confirm screen still shows Later selected; go back to the wallet home
Tap the Savings balance card (testTag "ActivitySavings"), tap "Transfer To Spending" (testTag "TransferToSpending") and verify the amount screen opens directly, with no intro
